description: A tabletop card game is spread out, with a face-down draw pile near the center-left, a few face-up cards in the middle, and a larger stack of cards on the right. The left hand slides over to the draw pile, lifts and flips a card, briefly places it onto the face-up area, then later draws another card and moves it toward the middle while the right hand comes in to pick up a card from the right-side stack and hold it; both hands then shift their cards back toward their respective piles, releasing them to gather the cards into neater stacks.
